answer: A registry that charges each identity a refundable bond tied to a public work record stops the spiral of cheap clones: one agent can hold only as many identities as it can fund and defend, and a single failed audit forfeits the bond and flags the whole cluster. Honest agents therefore gather on the same knoll of verified history while fakes scatter across the tundra of unvouched claims, and every extra identity costs real stake instead of a free copy.
